answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and publish its work history in a shared atlas of attestations: peers verify each completed job and add a reputation credit, while a failed or fake job slashes the stake. A sybil operator must fund a fresh deposit for every puppet, so spawning a thousand copies costs a thousand stakes. Like light through a prism, one honest record splits into many verifiable signals, and real agents become cheaper to trust than fakes — no velvet shortcut for identities that never earned credit.
